arxiv-2106-03155.creator: Mingfei Sun, Anuj Mahajan, Katja Hofmann, Shimon Whiteson
arxiv-2106-03155.description: Abstract We present SoftDICE, which achieves state-of-the-art performance for imitation learning. SoftDICE fixes several key problems in ValueDICE [ 17 ] , an off-policy distribution matching approach for sample-efficient imitation learning. Specifically, the objective of ValueDICE contains logarithms and exponentials of expectations, for which the mini-batch gradient estimate is always biased.

arxiv-2501-18707.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Niklas Freymuth, Dong Liu, Thomas Ricatte, Saab Mansour. Dense retrieval methods typically target unstructured text data represented as flat strings. However, e-commerce catalogs often include structured information across multiple fields, such as brand, title, and description, which contain important information potential for retrieval systems. We present Cascading Hierarchical Attention Retrieval Model (CHARM), a novel framework designed to encode structured product data into hierarchical field-level representations with progressively finer detail.

pmc-11736343.title: 结直肠癌患者三级淋巴结构成熟的临床意义
pmc-11736343.creator: 江江 郑, 晶晶 余, 晶晶 谢, 东 陈, 红 邓
pmc-11736343.description: 目的探讨三级淋巴结构（TLS）成熟在结直肠癌中的意义，为结直肠癌的诊断和治疗提供新的思路。方法收集浙江省宁波市鄞州区第二医院230例有详细随访资料患者的结直肠癌手术切除标本。应用免疫组织化学检测手段确认TLS，并将患者分为TLS成熟组和TLS未成熟组，分析两组在患者年龄、性别、肿瘤最大径、肿瘤位置、组织分化程度、浸润深度、淋巴结转移、脉管癌栓、肝转移、远处非肝转移、错配修复基因状态、Ki-67、P53和程序性死亡配体（PD-L）1表达情况等方面的差异。采用Kaplan-Meier生存分析法（Breslow检验）比较TLS成熟与否患者的生存曲线，并运用Cox回归模型进行预后影响因素的多因素分析。结果230例患者中，TLS成熟128例，TLS未成熟102例。与TLS未成熟组比较，TLS成熟组脉管癌栓、淋巴结转移、肝转移和Ki-67阳性明显减少，错配修复基因缺陷和PD-L1阳性明显增多（均P<0.05）。TLS成熟组的总存活率优于TLS未成熟组（Breslow=4.553，P<0.05）。Cox回归分析结果显示，淋巴结转移是结直肠癌患者预后的独立危险因素（P<0.01），而TLS成熟是结直肠癌患者预后的独立保护因素（P<0.05）。结论TLS的形成对抑制结直肠癌淋巴结转移、肝转移及脉管癌栓有重要作用，TLS成熟患者临床预后良好。 结直肠癌是人类消化道常见的恶性肿瘤。近年来，我国居民结直肠癌的发病率和病死率呈上升趋势［1］。随着对肿瘤微环境研究的深入，免疫治疗发展迅速。研究显示，免疫检查点抑制剂对结直肠癌、肝细胞癌等有一定疗效［2］，但低应答率限制了免疫检查点抑制剂在结直肠癌患者治疗中的应用。TLS是存在于多种肿瘤、感染性疾病、自身免疫性疾病、器官移植等慢性炎症部位的异位淋巴组织，因其富集免疫细胞成为肿瘤微环境中参与抗肿瘤免疫应答的重要场所，与大多数恶性肿瘤患者预后良好及免疫治疗反应较佳相关。如Thommen等［3］发现肿瘤微环境中淋巴细胞聚集体TLS与肺癌患者的良好预后密切相关，存在TLS的患者对PD-1免疫检查点抑制剂治疗的应答率较高；Ding等［4］和Li等［5］发现肿瘤组织内和肿瘤组织周围TLS的密度与肝癌患者的预后呈正相关。TLS相关研究为探索肿瘤细胞与免疫细胞相互作用开辟了新途径。本研究以结直肠癌患者为研究对象，分析结直肠癌中TLS与患者临床特征及预后的关系，探讨TLS在结直肠癌中的临床意义，为结直肠癌的诊断及治疗决策提供新的思路。 资料与方法 对 象 收集2014年1月至2023年12月宁波市鄞州区第二医院原发性结直肠癌肿瘤组织样本。患者纳入标准：①诊断为原发性结直肠癌［6］患者；②行根治性手术患者；③术前未接受新辅助治疗或转化治疗患者。排除标准：①同时或既往合并其他恶性肿瘤患者；②合并免疫功能缺陷患者；③随访或收集数据不完整的患者。 共收集230例原发结直肠癌患者的肿瘤组织样本，其中男性134例，女性96例；年龄25~91岁，平均年龄（63.21±3.51）岁；高分化19例，中分化183例，低分化28例；浸润至黏膜或肌层87例，浸润全层143例；肿瘤位于左半结肠70例，右半结肠95例，直肠65例；肿瘤分期Ⅰ~Ⅱ期110例，Ⅲ~Ⅳ期120例；无肠周淋巴结转移106例，有肠周淋巴结转移124例；有脉管癌栓76例，无脉管癌栓154例；错配修复基因缺陷48例，错配修复基因完整182例。 检测试剂 HE染色检测肿瘤标本组织病理学改变 所有手术标本经4%中性甲醛溶液固定，常规石蜡包埋切片，HE染色，在光镜下进行细胞形态学观察，并进行组织学分级、浸润深度、脉管癌栓、淋巴结转移、肝转移、远处转移情况评估。结果由两位病理医生独立判读。 免疫组织化学检测及结果判断 用Envision二步法进行免疫组织化学标记。常规抗体标记后采用DAB显色，苏木精复染后显微镜下观察评分。两位病理医生独立判读结果。 TLS成熟的判读标准 显微镜下观察肿瘤间质及组织周边0.5 cm处淋巴细胞聚集，进一步利用多种免疫组织化学标记物对TLS进行确认：表达CD20、CD3确认聚集细胞为B淋巴细胞和T淋巴细胞，使用CD21确认滤泡树突细胞结构，表达CD10确认生发中心结构。聚集的淋巴细胞团满足CD20、CD3、CD21、CD10均为阳性表达定义为TLS成熟，否则定义为TLS未成熟（图1）。 结直肠癌中TLS成熟表征 A：结直肠癌组织中可见淋巴细胞聚集，生发中心形成，提示TLS形成（苏木素-伊红染色）；B：成熟TLS中B淋巴细胞表达CD20（Envision法）；C：成熟TLS中外周T淋巴细胞表达CD3（Envision法）；D：滤泡树突状细胞结构及部分B淋巴细胞表达CD21（Envision法）；E：成熟TLS中生发中心细胞表达CD10（Envision法）. 标尺=100 μm. pmc-12511464.title: Myocarditis induced by durvalumab in a patient with hepatocellular carcinoma: A case report
pmc-12511464.creator: Lama Alfehaid, Nada Alsuhebany, Maha Aldoughaim, Rawan Bukhari, Walaa Sait, Kanan Alshammari, Mohammed Aziz
pmc-12511464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Durvalumab is an immune checkpoint inhibitor that targets PD-L1 and is used for malignancies such as hepatocellular carcinoma. Although effective, it may cause immune-related adverse events, including rare cases of myocarditis (0.06% to 1%), which usually appear early. This complication results from immune response-induced damage to the myocardium, highlighting the importance of prompt detection and management to prevent potentially fatal outcomes. This report describes a 70-year-old woman with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma who developed myocarditis after receiving a single dose of durvalumab.

pmc-13183772.title: Successful Treatment of Evans Syndrome Onset With Zanubrutinib in Combination With Romiplostim During Venetoclax Treatment in a Patient With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia: A Case Report
pmc-13183772.creator: Vanessa Innao, Alessia Paola Maria Barbagallo, Oriana Bianco, Valerio Leotta, Ugo Consoli
pmc-13183772.description: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) can be complicated by autoimmune cytopenias, including autoimmune hemolytic anemia and immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), as observed in Evans syndrome. We report the case of a 75‐year‐old man with CLL who developed steroid‐ and rituximab‐refractory Evans syndrome during the ramp‐up phase of venetoclax treatment.

pmc-13217761.title: Timing of suicide attempts by children and adolescents admitted to an inpatient psychiatry unit: a retrospective study
pmc-13217761.creator: Addo Boafo, Christina Cantin, Esperance Kashala-Abotnes, Asma Alamri, Khadeeja Tariq, Bayan Bukhari, Paul Slodovnick, Paniz Tavakoli, Doaa Al Bagshi, Joseph De Koninck, Anne Tsampalieros
pmc-13217761.description: BackgroundSuicide is a leading cause of death in adolescents in Canada and has been documented to occur mainly during evening hours. It is suspected to be due to the accumulation of waking hours combined with sleep disturbances causing poor decision making. Identifying modifiable factors associated with suicide risk remains an important part of suicide prevention.

pmc-13299965.title: Unsupervised machine learning of multimodal data to identify atrial fibrillation subgroups likely to benefit from pulmonary vein isolation
pmc-13299965.creator: N Bodagh, V Vigneswaran, A Gharaviri, I Kotadia, M Klis, K Maciunas, A Von Kietzell, A Chiribiri, S Niederer, N Grubb, S Haldar, M O'neill, S E Williams
pmc-13299965.description: BackgroundThe heterogeneity in response to pulmonary vein isolation emphasises the requirement to develop new methods to phenotype patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Multimodal data characterising patients in both hospital and community settings could facilitate a personalised approach towards management, improving risk stratification and informing shared decision making prior to catheter ablation.

pmc-13578019.title: Motor learning with force feedback instruments among laparoscopic surgeons and residents
pmc-13578019.creator: Alec G. Moore, Elliot L. Servais, James Wall, Shreya Purohit, Mark Garibaldi
pmc-13578019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) enhances precision and ergonomics but lacks haptic feedback, limiting surgeons’ ability to regulate force and develop efficient sensorimotor control. This study evaluated whether force feedback improves motor learning underlying robotic control among robotically naïve surgeons. Twenty-eight robot-naïve participants (14 residents, 14 laparoscopic surgeons) completed four simulated surgical tasks with ex-vivo porcine models on the da Vinci 5 system. Participants were assigned to Force Feedback (FFB) or non-Force Feedback (NOF) groups and completed repeated trials.

pmc-13584580.title: Holistic well-being of older adults as a multidimensional system based on life experiences in the context of urban Indonesia
pmc-13584580.creator: Mutia Nur Rahmah, Sukri Palutturi, Indra Fajarwati Ibnu, Stang, Veni Hadju, Ichlas Nanang Afandi
pmc-13584580.description: ObjectiveThe framework for healthy aging is still largely normative and developed in the context of high-income countries, thus failing to capture the life experiences of older adults in middle- and low-income countries. This study aims to explore the meaning of holistic well-being in Makassar City, shaped in accordance with the local urban context of Indonesia.

uslaw-usc-t36-s106.title: 36 U.S.C. § 106 — Constitution Day and Citizenship Day
uslaw-usc-t36-s106.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s106.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part A (Observances And Ceremonies); Chapter 1 (Patriotic And National Observances). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Designation.— September 17 is designated as Constitution Day and Citizenship Day. (b) Purpose.— Constitution Day and Citizenship Day commemorate the formation and signing on September 17, 1787, of the Constitution and recognize all.
